items.label: Elegant Natural Silver Design — Modern, Clean & Stylish
items.value: A soft Natural Silver finish adds a modern and elegant look to your workspace, making it ideal for students, young professionals, and anyone who prefers a clean and aesthetic setup

items.label: Lightweight & Portable — Easy to Carry for School or Travel
items.value: Slim and lightweight design fits easily into backpacks, making it perfect for school, commuting, library study sessions, travel, and everyday use

items.label: Smooth Everyday Performance with Intel Processor & 8GB DDR RAM
items.value: Designed for real daily needs with smooth performance for homework, web browsing, Google Classroom, Zoom calls, streaming, and light office tasks

items.label: 128GB Storage with Cloud-Friendly Workflow
items.value: Includes 128GB internal storage, suitable for essential files and applications. Perfect for users who rely on cloud storage solutions such as OneDrive or Google Drive for expanded space.

items.label: Windows 11 with Copilot AI
items.value: Preloaded with Windows 11 and Copilot AI to help with research, summaries, and everyday productivity.
